```{r pkgs, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(survival)
library(simsurv)
library(tidyverse); theme_set(theme_bw())
```

```{r seed}
set.seed(427)
```

```{r try1, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
n <- 30
lambda <- 0.15  
t_event <- rexp(n, rate = lambda)  
t_cens  <- runif(n, min = 1, max = 10) 

time   <- pmin(t_event, t_cens)  
status <- as.integer(t_event <= t_cens)  

dat <- data.frame(id = 1:n, t_event, t_cens, time, status)

dat <- dat |>
  mutate(type = ifelse(status == 1, "event", "censored")) |>
  arrange(time) |>
  mutate(order = row_number()) |>
  select(-t_event, -t_cens) |>
  relocate(order) 

fit <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ 1, data = dat)

sf <- summary(fit)
km_df <- data.frame(time = sf$time, surv = sf$surv, n.censor = sf$n.censor)
km_df <- rbind(data.frame(time = 0, surv = 1, n.censor = 0), km_df)  # 起点 S(0)=1

ggplot(km_df, aes(time, surv)) +
  geom_step(size = 1.1) +                                        # KM 阶梯
  geom_point(data = subset(km_df, n.censor > 0),                 # 删失标记
             shape = 3, size = 2, stroke = 0.9) +                # "+" 号
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .02))) +
  labs(title = "Kaplan–Meier Curve", x = "Time", y = "Survival Probability") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```
